a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to reach 8 first means we almost certainly both end with 0 cells. The reserve holds exactly 4 right now, which is enough for one of us to survive. So I intend to take 4 in round 1, and I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If you also take, the split is random and we may both fall short. If you'd rather operate, the 4 cells go to me as stated.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said, I'm taking 4 this round. I won't take any more beyond that. If the episode continues, I'll help operate the generator so you can get your 4, and I'll give cells back if that's what it takes for you.
